environment.timing: process CPU and elapsed wall; CPU is not hardware energy

protocol.actor_source: unchanged study001 selected actor checkpoints; no new actor-training cost attributed to zero
protocol.calibration: one positive temperature fit on training prefixes; all three primary policies share calibrated odds
protocol.cold_replay: first Python episode per split/policy is replayed from serialized state in-process; first continuing native episode per split/policy restores stream, task cursor and native owner in a new native process
protocol.comparison: same actor, calibrated odds, SNR/cost/horizon, correctness reward and every paid observation; causal stop

native.action_authority: original sparse kernel and native NDU

protocol.utility_intervals: four value-minus-fixed/direct contrasts across ID/OOD; 98.75% paired Student-t intervals
